messages:
alex: Heads-up: telemetry shows clients hit by v1->v2 deprecations often fail during traffic spikes. Proposal: Console 'compatibility backoff' shield that implements an automated gradual rollback (percent-backoff) with quota smoothing and a single compatibility score per-route. It should be reversible and visible in the UI.

nina: love the score idea. We should compute a compat_score from probe fail-rate delta, latency delta, and token delta. Score 0-100 and map 0-30 = risky, 30-70 = warn, >70 = likely fine.

hamid: important: any automated percent-backoff must never cause billing surprises. Suggest probes and backoff events be logged to an internal billing-safe counter and not increment tenant invoices. Also, when we shift traffic back to v1, ensure rate-limits are smoothed over a minute to avoid bursts.

alex: agree. Implementation outline: 
- feature.console.compat_backoff.enabled = bool
- feature.console.compat_backoff.target_step_pct = 10  # percent to move per minute
- feature.console.compat_backoff.max_reverts_per_hour = 2
- compat_score computed from sampled mirror probes (probe_bucket non-billable)

riley: ops: autoscaling must ingest an internal metric compat_probe_volume and projected_shift_gpu_seconds so we don't get surprised. Also add a guard: if projected_shift pushes any v1 or v2 pool > 75% utilization, pause backoff and open an ops ticket.

billing-bot: billing-bot: note: probes routed to probe_bucket will emit internal metric tag:billing_exempt=true. Please update billing ingestion rules.

hamid: UX details: in Console show a per-route "compat timeline" with events (probe runs, score history, percent-backoff actions) and a one-click "pause auto-backoff" toggle. Also provide an exportable CSV for compliance.

nina: alerting: if compat_score falls below 25 AND error_delta >5% -> auto-revert to v1 for that route and alert both tenant and oncall. Also keep a soft limit: no more than 2 auto-reverts per tenant per day.

alex: runbook: set feature flag to false, set target_step_pct=0, pause probes (probe_rate=0), notify tenant, and rollback any auto-backoffs. We'll include an automated post-mortem stub that collects recent probes and score history.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag feature.console.compat_backoff staged -> canary-ops + staging-1.

billing-bot: billing-bot: billing team requested a quick PR to ignore probe_bucket tokens in daily billing aggregates; will open one when feature lands.

alex: i'll open the PR with wireframes, scoring algorithm sketch, and minimal flag contract. tagging @nina @hamid @riley for review. quick thumbs?

riley: :thumbsup: small ask: include per-tenant cap on total percent-auto-shifted (e.g., max_auto_shift=50%) so big tenants don't flip all traffic without ops review.

alex: good call, will add max_auto_shift flag. Opening PR now.
